references.label: Creature progress
references.description: Ramp advances and starts the Creature multiball route.

references.label: Multiball conversion shot
references.description: North Pole is one of the shots used during Creature 2-Ball.

references.label: Multiball conversion shot
references.description: Geneva completes the conversion from Creature 2-Ball.

references.label: Jackpot lane
references.description: Left lane can be one of the moving multiball jackpot shots.

references.label: Creature 2-Ball start
references.description: The right orbit can start Creature 2-Ball and normally feeds the bumpers.

references.label: Sarcophagus scoop
references.description: The scoop spots FRANKENSTEIN letters and can convert Creature 2-Ball or light the Super Jackpot.

references.label: Ice Cave
references.description: The upper-flipper shot spots letters, supplies awards, and can be a moving Jackpot location.

references.label: Move Jackpot target
references.description: The standup rotates the two active Jackpot locations during the main multiball.
